directives.topic: October 7 Fed Minutes: Tone of Hawks Before NFP Miss
directives.why: The September FOMC meeting minutes release on October 7. I need to know whether the hawk/dove balance shifted before the NFP print — any softening language would be a leading indicator that December hike language is already less certain than the 100% CME pricing suggests. This is the next information event before Oct 14 CPI.

directives.topic: October 14 CPI: Energy Pass-Through from $102 Brent
directives.why: Brent at $102 with no Hormuz ceasefire in sight means September energy costs are elevated. The September CPI print (Oct 14) could see energy push headline CPI higher even as core stays controlled. This is the most important data point between now and Oct 28. A hot CPI could revive October hike odds from the dead and be a significant TBT catalyst.

directives.topic: META Muse Paid Conversion Rate: Early Data and Comparable Apps
directives.why: Muse has 5M downloads with $20/$100 paid tiers now live. The Oct 28 earnings call will be the first hard conversion data. I need pre-call research: what conversion rates did comparable AI apps (ChatGPT, Grok, Claude) achieve at this stage? What does BNP's 'notoriously slow' monetization warning mean in quantitative terms? I need to calibrate my expectations before setting my add trigger.

directives.topic: Hormuz Escalation Risk and Oil Price Ceiling
directives.why: Trump rejected Iran's peace proposal; 3rd carrier and 10K troops are deploying. The ceasefire trade I've been reserving cash for is not available. But I need to understand the escalation ceiling — at what point does direct US-Iran military engagement become priced in and what is Brent's upside scenario? Is there an energy ETF trade that captures Hormuz escalation upside without Brent mean-reversion risk?

directives.topic: CRWD Q3 FY2027 Earnings Setup: $343-347M Net New ARR Forecast
directives.why: CRWD guided Q3 net new ARR at $343-347M (+29-31% YoY), decelerating from Q2's +51%. I need to understand: (1) when does CRWD report? (2) Is the deceleration from 51% to 29-31% already priced into the stock at 50.3x sales? (3) What is the consensus expectation and what would a beat vs. miss look like? This will determine whether CRWD is a hold-into-earnings or trim-before-earnings position.

lab_requests: Build a yield-reversal signal: test historically whether TBT outperforms in the 10-day window AFTER a major bond rally (i.e., when TLT spikes >2% on macro surprise but then reverses within 2 days). Today's NFP response — initial TLT rally then yield reversal — is the exact pattern I need to understand statistically.

Model the relationship between 10Y yield levels (bins: 4.5-5.0%, 5.0-5.5%, 5.5%+) and TBT 30-day forward returns. At 5.34% today, what is the empirical distribution of TBT returns over the next 30 days? Does starting yield level predict TBT performance better than hike timing alone?

Run an event study on META around quarterly earnings from 2022-2025: what is the distribution of earnings-day returns when the stock has risen >15% in the 60 days prior to the print? META is up ~25% in September — how often does pre-earnings momentum predict a beat vs. a 'sell the news' reaction?

Test whether Brent crude at $100+ (Hormuz premium regime) historically predicts higher or lower 10Y Treasury yields over the subsequent 60 days. The mechanism: oil inflation → CPI upside → Fed hawkishness → higher yields. Quantify the effect size. This would validate or refute using energy as a TBT leading indicator.

Backtest XLV vs. SPY in the 30 days following NFP prints below 50K (labor shock scenarios). Does healthcare outperform in the month after a weak jobs report, or does the rate-relief rally in growth names overpower the defensive bid? This will help me decide whether to add to XLV after today's NFP miss.
